ticket_conservation.rule: raw = resolved + rejected per route string, each ticket exactly once

rider_minutes.rule: stretch rider-minutes + excluded + moved = resolved-ticket rider-minutes

supply.rule: rider volume with no scheduled bus after the fallback stays under 1%

run_times.rule: modelled hourly run times within 15% of ticket-pair run times

time_zone.rule: fixture tests (tests/test_clean.py, tests/test_config.py, tests/test_loads_riders.py) pin every operation to Asia/Kolkata

finite.rule: no NaN or inf in people_mid/low/high or E_r

radial.definition: radial = not a ring, nearer terminal within 8 km of CP/ITO and the farther one at least 5 km farther out; inbound = towards the terminal nearer CP/ITO; the network hits a part when more than half of route pairs do

chance.method: seeded simulation, 2000 draws per corridor, seed 25, stretches drawn without replacement from the 13,181 weekday stretches with service

corridors.mapping: A stretch is mapped when either end's stop name is in the corridor's list (and, where a direction is stated, it heads that way); both-ends is shown as a stricter reading. With this many mapped stretches a hit is likely even by chance, so the share of mapped stretches in the top decile (10% would be chance) and the chance of a hit are shown too

gps_stoptime.note: GPS aggregates do not exist yet; not counted as a miss

repeatability.method: Leave-one-out: levels are recomputed from the other weekday blocks (T). Week pairs: each block alone (H) is compared with another block alone, which is the independent week-to-week test. Weekend days stay in every run so the operator scale has the same basis. Cells are weekday commuter-facing cells present in both runs; rider-weighted by full-month app riders.

dtc_bus_km.rho_source: none: GPS aggregates not available, so every scheduled trip counts as run
dtc_bus_km.basis: each scheduled trip's stretches once (one passing per trip per stop, stretch = stop k to k+1, rings capped at n_stops-1), on the feed's single service day (one service_id), the per-day basis of the published figure

load_factor.definition: weekday passenger-km / seat-km over scheduled service on commuter-facing cells (people on board capped at crush load; seats, not rated totals)
load_factor.published_note: DTC 88-89%, cluster 78% (Economic Survey of Delhi 2025-26, ch. 12); definitions differ, so this is a rough check

gps_stoptime.note: GPS aggregates do not exist yet; not counted as a miss

independent.field_count: not possible; no on-bus counts exist

comfortable.description: comfortable-capacity thresholds (12 m 77/79, 9 m 32) replace the rated totals

vehicle_rule_90.description: 9 m vehicle rule at 90% instead of 50%

no_capacity_bound.description: capacity bound switched off (E = operator scale on every route)

ceiling_2x.description: E* ceiling 2 x E_op instead of 3 x

ceiling_5x.description: E* ceiling 5 x E_op instead of 3 x
